result.reason: The added language covers professional/workmanlike performance, a 90-day software/deliverable conformance warranty, and repair, replacement, re-performance, or refund remedies, substantially reaching the duration fallback. However, it omits the required compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code warranties. It also limits conformance coverage to the Interface and Support Services deliverables rather than clearly covering all software and deliverables, and it does not clearly state a 30- or 90-day warranty period for services. Reordering Section 11 and the disclaimer is unnecessary and creates ambiguity as to which “Section” contains the protected express warranties. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
